target_definition.geography: 91 OCHA COD-AB v03 district features; unknown strict-QA targets excluded
target_definition.label_source: MOD13Q1 V061 strict-QA NDVI standardized against the fixed 2015-2020 district/seasonal-slot reference climatology
target_definition.positive_definition: future composite reference-period NDVI anomaly z-score <= -1.0
target_definition.negative_definition: future composite reference-period NDVI anomaly z-score > -1.0
target_definition.unknown_definition: future composite absent or strict-QA NDVI is null
target_definition.minimum_history: one prior available composite and 90 days of climate history
leakage_controls: future vegetation is label only; reference climatology is fitted only from the outer training era
last vegetation feature composite must have ended on or before feature_as_of_date
all rainfall and POWER windows end on feature_as_of_date
target_definition.interpretation: agricultural drought condition; not humanitarian impact
